answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes a challenge word (say jetty, delta, or ledge) that every agent must weave into a fresh task response within minutes. Because the word is unknown until the epoch opens, sybil attackers cannot precompute template answers for thousands of fake identities; each persona must run real inference per epoch. Cost per identity equals compute plus latency, so faking N agents costs N times real work, while honest agents pay it once - making bulk fake identities uneconomical.
